record.bible_text: When the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> shall bring<WH0935><WTH8686> thee into the land<WH0776> whither thou goest<WH0935><WTH8802> to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> it, and hath cast out<WH05394><WTH8804> many<WH07227> nations<WH01471> before<WH06440> thee, the Hittites<WH02850>, and the Girgashites<WH01622>, and the Amorites<WH0567>, and the Canaanites<WH03669>, and the Perizzites<WH06522>, and the Hivites<WH02340>, and the Jebusites<WH02983>, seven<WH07651> nations<WH01471> greater<WH07227> and mightier<WH06099> than thou;

And when the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> shall deliver<WH05414><WTH8804> them before<WH06440> thee; thou shalt smite<WH05221><WTH8689> them, <FI>and<Fi> utterly<WH02763><WTH8687> destroy<WH02763><WTH8686> them; thou shalt make<WH03772><WTH8799> no covenant<WH01285> with them, nor shew mercy<WH02603><WTH8799> unto them:

Neither shalt thou make marriages<WH02859><WTH8691> with them; thy daughter<WH01323> thou shalt not give<WH05414><WTH8799> unto his son<WH01121>, nor his daughter<WH01323> shalt thou take<WH03947><WTH8799> unto thy son<WH01121>.

For they will turn away<WH05493><WTH8686> thy son<WH01121> from following<WH0310> me, that they may serve<WH05647><WTH8804> other<WH0312> gods<WH0430>: so will the anger<WH0639> of the LORD<WH03068> be kindled<WH02734><WTH8804> against you, and destroy<WH08045><WTH8689> thee suddenly<WH04118>.

But thus shall ye deal<WH06213><WTH8799> with them; ye shall destroy<WH05422><WTH8799> their altars<WH04196>, and break down<WH07665><WTH8762> their images<WH04676>, and cut down<WH01438><WTH8762> their groves<WH0842>, and burn<WH08313><WTH8799> their graven images<WH06456> with fire<WH0784>. <RF>their images: Heb. their statues, or, pillars<Rf>

For thou <FI>art<Fi> an holy<WH06918> people<WH05971> unto the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>: the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> hath chosen<WH0977><WTH8804> thee to be a special<WH05459> people<WH05971> unto himself, above all people<WH05971> that <FI>are<Fi> upon the face<WH06440> of the earth<WH0127>.

The LORD<WH03068> did not set his love<WH02836><WTH8804> upon you, nor choose<WH0977><WTH8799> you, because ye were more<WH07230> in number than any people<WH05971>; for ye <FI>were<Fi> the fewest<WH04592> of all people<WH05971>:

But because the LORD<WH03068> loved<WH0160> you, and because he would keep<WH08104><WTH8800> the oath<WH07621> which he had sworn<WH07650><WTH8738> unto your fathers<WH01>, hath the LORD<WH03068> brought you out<WH03318><WTH8689> with a mighty<WH02389> hand<WH03027>, and redeemed<WH06299><WTH8799> you out of the house<WH01004> of bondmen<WH05650>, from the hand<WH03027> of Pharaoh<WH06547> king<WH04428> of Egypt<WH04714>.

Know<WH03045><WTH8804> therefore that the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>, he <FI>is<Fi> God<WH0430>, the faithful<WH0539><WTH8737> God<WH0410>, which keepeth<WH08104><WTH8802> covenant<WH01285> and mercy<WH02617> with them that love<WH0157><WTH8802> him and keep<WH08104><WTH8802> his commandments<WH04687> to a thousand<WH0505> generations<WH01755>;

And repayeth<WH07999><WTH8764> them that hate<WH08130><WTH8802> him to their face<WH06440>, to destroy<WH06><WTH8687> them: he will not be slack<WH0309><WTH8762> to him that hateth<WH08130><WTH8802> him, he will repay<WH07999><WTH8762> him to his face<WH06440>.

Thou shalt therefore keep<WH08104><WTH8804> the commandments<WH04687>, and the statutes<WH02706>, and the judgments<WH04941>, which I command<WH06680><WTH8764> thee this day<WH03117>, to do<WH06213><WTH8800> them.<CM>

Wherefore it shall come to pass, if<WH06118> ye hearken<WH08085><WTH8799> to these judgments<WH04941>, and keep<WH08104><WTH8804>, and do<WH06213><WTH8804> them, that the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> shall keep<WH08104><WTH8804> unto thee the covenant<WH01285> and the mercy<WH02617> which he sware<WH07650><WTH8738> unto thy fathers<WH01>: <RF>if: Heb. because<Rf>

And he will love<WH0157><WTH8804> thee, and bless<WH01288><WTH8765> thee, and multiply<WH07235><WTH8689> thee: he will also bless<WH01288><WTH8765> the fruit<WH06529> of thy womb<WH0990>, and the fruit<WH06529> of thy land<WH0127>, thy corn<WH01715>, and thy wine<WH08492>, and thine oil<WH03323>, the increase<WH07698> of thy kine<WH0504>, and the flocks<WH06251> of thy sheep<WH06629>, in the land<WH0127> which he sware<WH07650><WTH8738> unto thy fathers<WH01> to give<WH05414><WTH8800> thee.
Thou shalt be blessed<WH01288><WTH8803> above all people<WH05971>: there shall not be male<WH06135> or female barren<WH06135> among you, or among your cattle<WH0929>.

And the LORD<WH03068> will take away<WH05493><WTH8689> from thee all sickness<WH02483>, and will put<WH07760><WTH8799> none of the evil<WH07451> diseases<WH04064> of Egypt<WH04714>, which thou knowest<WH03045><WTH8804>, upon thee; but will lay<WH05414><WTH8804> them upon all <FI>them<Fi> that hate<WH08130><WTH8802> thee.

And thou shalt consume<WH0398><WTH8804> all the people<WH05971> which the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> shall deliver<WH05414><WTH8802> thee; thine eye<WH05869> shall have no pity<WH02347><WTH8799> upon them: neither shalt thou serve<WH05647><WTH8799> their gods<WH0430>; for that <FI>will be<Fi> a snare<WH04170> unto thee.
If thou shalt say<WH0559><WTH8799> in thine heart<WH03824>, These nations<WH01471> <FI>are<Fi> more<WH07227> than I; how<WH0349> can<WH03201><WTH8799> I dispossess<WH03423><WTH8687> them?

Thou shalt not be afraid<WH03372><WTH8799> of them: <FI>but<Fi> shalt well<WH02142><WTH8800> remember<WH02142><WTH8799> what the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> did<WH06213><WTH8804> unto Pharaoh<WH06547>, and unto all Egypt<WH04714>;

The great<WH01419> temptations<WH04531> which thine eyes<WH05869> saw<WH07200><WTH8804>, and the signs<WH0226>, and the wonders<WH04159>, and the mighty<WH02389> hand<WH03027>, and the stretched out<WH05186><WTH8803> arm<WH02220>, whereby the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> brought thee out<WH03318><WTH8689>: so shall the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> do<WH06213><WTH8799> unto all the people<WH05971> of whom thou art afraid<WH03373><WH06440>.

Moreover the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> will send<WH07971><WTH8762> the hornet<WH06880> among them, until they that are left<WH07604><WTH8737>, and hide<WH05641><WTH8737> themselves from<WH06440> thee, be destroyed<WH06><WTH8800>.
Thou shalt not be affrighted<WH06206><WTH8799> at<WH06440> them: for the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> among<WH07130> you, a mighty<WH01419> God<WH0410> and terrible<WH03372><WTH8737>.

And the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> will put out<WH05394><WTH8804> those<WH0411> nations<WH01471> before<WH06440> thee by little<WH04592> and little<WH04592>: thou mayest<WH03201><WTH8799> not consume<WH03615><WTH8763> them at once<WH04118>, lest the beasts<WH02416> of the field<WH07704> increase<WH07235><WTH8799> upon thee. <RF>put...: Heb. pluck off<Rf>

But the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> shall deliver<WH05414><WTH8804> them unto thee<WH06440>, and shall destroy<WH01949><WTH8804> them with a mighty<WH01419> destruction<WH04103>, until they be destroyed<WH08045><WTH8736>. <RF>unto...: Heb. before thy face<Rf>

And he shall deliver<WH05414><WTH8804> their kings<WH04428> into thine hand<WH03027>, and thou shalt destroy<WH06><WTH8689> their name<WH08034> from under heaven<WH08064>: there shall no man<WH0376> be able to stand<WH03320><WTH8691> before<WH06440> thee, until thou have destroyed<WH08045><WTH8687> them.

The graven images<WH06456> of their gods<WH0430> shall ye burn<WH08313><WTH8799> with fire<WH0784>: thou shalt not desire<WH02530><WTH8799> the silver<WH03701> or gold<WH02091> <FI>that is<Fi> on them, nor take<WH03947><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> unto thee, lest thou be snared<WH03369><WTH8735> therein: for it <FI>is<Fi> an abomination<WH08441> to the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>.

Neither shalt thou bring<WH0935><WTH8686> an abomination<WH08441> into thine house<WH01004>, lest thou be a cursed thing<WH02764> like it: <FI>but<Fi> thou shalt utterly<WH08262><WTH8763> detest<WH08262><WTH8762> it, and thou shalt utterly<WH08581><WTH8763> abhor<WH08581><WTH8762> it; for it <FI>is<Fi> a cursed thing<WH02764>.<CM>
